# Lifespan timeline of presidents of South Africa__disambig_1

This is a graphical lifespan timeline of presidents of South Africa.  The presidents are listed in order of office.
ImageSize  = width:$width height:$height
PlotArea   = right:10 left:1 bottom:80 top:60
Period     = from:$start till:$end
TimeAxis   = orientation:horizontal
Legend = orientation:vertical position:bottom columns:1
Colors =
id:bg              value:white
id:lightline       value:rgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
id:lighttext       value:rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
id:LIFESPAN        value:rgb(0.88, 0.90, 0.70) Legend: Lifespan
id:PRES_ANC        value:rgb(0, 0.4, 0) Legend: African_National_Congress
id:NAME            value:rgb(0.15, 0.13, 0.05)
id:TODAY           value:lightpurple
BackgroundColors = canvas:bg
ScaleMinor = gridcolor:lightline unit:year increment:1 start:$start
ScaleMajor = gridcolor:lighttext unit:year increment:10 start:1920
Define $dy = -5 # shift text to button side of bar
LineData=
at:$now color:TODAY width:0.1
PlotData=
bar:1 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1918 till:1994 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Nelson Mandela
color:PRES_ANC
from:1994 till:1999
color:LIFESPAN
from:1999 till:2013
bar:2 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1942 till:1999 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Thabo Mbeki
color:PRES_ANC
from:1999 till:2008
color:LIFESPAN
from:2008 till:$now
bar:3 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1949 till:2008 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Kgalema Motlanthe
color:PRES_ANC
from:2008 till:2009
color:LIFESPAN
from:2009 till:$now
bar:4 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1942 till:2009 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Jacob Zuma
color:PRES_ANC
from:2009 till:2018
color:LIFESPAN
from:2018 till:$now
bar:5 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1952 till:2018 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Cyril Ramaphosa
color:PRES_ANC
from:2018 till:$now

fontsize:M
textcolor:red
